basic_info.description:
Situated in the Mt. Davidson Manor area, this lovely neighborhood gives you the best of both worlds, quiet residential living yet close to all the City has to offer.
51 Dorado Terrace is a spacious, bright, top floor 3bd, 2ba. apartment with 2 car parking.
Features include:
* Top floor apartment in 2 unit bldg.
* Skylights 
* large eat in kitchen with plenty of
 New counter space, cabinets. Dual 
 Ovens, dishwasher.
* Dining and living room boasts an
 Open floor plan with great city views
 Terrific for entertaining! Decorative 
 Fireplace and built in 
 bookcases. 
* Master bedroom & 2 good sized. 
 Bedrooms, all with good closet 
 Space.
* Personal Washer/dryer 
* Garage parking for 1 car and
 Driveway parking for 1 car.
* Shared garden & patio.

Terrific neighborhood. Close to shopping. Whole Foods, many restaurants, steps to Muni, minutes to BART. 19th Ave, highways 101& 280 & Stonestown Galleria.
Contact ad to schedule an appointment. 
**Rental application can be picked up at the viewing and returned with:
** A current credit report with FICO score.
** Also paystubs or if new position,
An offer letter.
** Total income approximately 3x rent.

Will consider a cat.
.

One year, Residents pay all utilities
